threats.description: An attacker on the internet tampers with HTTP requests handled by the reverse proxy (request smuggling / header injection) to reach internal services.
Authentication or session spoofing against the Magento storefront lets the attacker act as a legitimate customer or admin.
Sensitive customer and order data is exposed by the storefront through an information disclosure flaw.
The MariaDB backend leaks customer PII and payment-related records to an attacker who has pivoted from the application tier.
The Redis session/cache store is tampered with to poison cached content or hijack authenticated sessions.
A back-office administrator browses malicious content and the vulnerable browser is exploited to gain code execution on the admin workstation.
